verdict.rationale: Docs show strong first-party support for cross-calendar sync (smart copies of events across 'all of your schedules') and automatic conflict avoidance/rescheduling of lower-priority events, which is the core of the story. However, the docs never explicitly name Google/Outlook/Apple support, and community comments raise doubts specifically about Office 365/Exchange support ('can't tell if it has Exchange support, I assume not'; 'the moment you support Office365... you can have all my money') plus a hands-on report that cross-account syncing 'didn't work' as expected. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming Google/Outlook/Apple as supported calendar providers, and independent confirmation that conflict-checking reliably works across all three without gaps.
